newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close lower in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close lower in continuous trade.

text.p: Four stocks closed lower, two higher and one was flat in 4.3-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Friday.
NFI units fell to 148 zlotys in a 14.1-million-zloty turnover.
The continuous trading system, which currently lists 15 companies, is separate from the bourse's main single-price auction system in which the same firms and 68 others are traded.
At the single-price auction session most stocks rose and the main market's index gained 0.7 percent.
